summary: Separate English and Korean first-party discovery found no Hyesan-local public cadastral viewer, parcel API, or safe parcel geometry. Naenara material only establishes general development-zone/cartographic context. Direct requests failed TLS/transport checks; no exception or bypass was used. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: Queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-3208-hyesan.json. South Korean K-GeoP was excluded as a different jurisdiction. General Korean research was not treated as local registry evidence.
requestOutcomes: Three routes were attempted: Naenara homepage and PDF failed certificate verification; KCNA transport negotiation failed. No credentials, CAPTCHA solving, TLS disablement, private tokens, unsafe fields, parcel IDs, or geometry were requested or retained.
scopeLimits: No Hyesan-local registry custodian, public cadastral procedure, viewer, service configuration, API schema, CRS, or native parcel identity was verified.
No exact WUP-point hit or miss was obtained; exact point remains [41.4063739816558, 128.19280427884] in latitude/longitude order.
A general Hyesan Economic Development Zone map is not parcel evidence and does not establish citywide coverage.
TLS and transport failures are access limitations, not evidence of source absence.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.

credentials, private tokens and personal data
